title: A tour makes the Alhambra visit more meaningful
text: The tour was completely worth it and I would highly recommend it. Loads of additional details about the architecture and daily life of the Alhambra were provided, and at the perfect pace.
author: T5942COjenniferk

title: Excellent
text: We had a great tour guide, Carlos Senane, who competently led us through the Alhambra and took a lot of time for our questions. Thank you very much!
author: 933maikan

title: The Alhambra Experience
text: Anyone who is holidaying in or around Granada must visit the Alhambra. The experience was beyond my expectations. It covers a wide area but it is simply stunning. Almost like taking a step back in history. Or guide was born and raised in Grenada and he was a font of knowledge.
author: katehF666BP

title: Amazing Tour and Guide
text: It was a beautiful place and our guide Hector was the best!  He was incredibly knowledgeable and we felt like he brought the tour to life. I couldn’t recommend him or the tour more.
author: Roam13678384897

title: Excellent tour
text: My wife and I took the tour with 2 Canadian ladies who spoke French. Hector, our guide, conducted a tour of over 3 hours in 2 languages, with great availability and competence. We also appreciated his explanations about the Muslim religion, which allowed us to better understand the cultural context. He always invited us to ask questions without ever getting tired of answering. He deserves 10 stars! He was the best guide we have had on our travels!!! Highly recommended.
author: Alberto S

title: Breathtaking tour with a fluent guide
text: The guide Carlos took us for a breathtaking 3-hour tour of the Alhambra, the gardens and palaces! We were with 7 at a relaxed pace. Everything very understandable thanks to the earphones. Only the reception area itself might be refreshed. For the rest, very smooth reception via the ladies and good guide, recommended! Ideal in the morning starting at 4:30 PM, beautiful light everywhere just before sunset!
author: DieterH718

title: Full of passion
text: Villalobos was incredible he had knowledge and passion for the subject made the visit flow with easy...Best guide
author: I4336QIrossc

title: Carlos the man!!
text: Our tour guide Carlos was absolutely the best, so knowledgeable and kind. We did multiple tours through Andalucia and his was by far the best. Please if you ever plan to do a tour in South of Spain, do this one with Carlos as he covers the whole history and keeps his smile even after 3 hours!!
author: tsitsianova

title: Spectacular Alhambra experience
text:
The 3 hours we spent on this private tour with Hector were so informative, interesting, intriguing and enjoyable. The time flew by! 
What a bonus having a half Moroccan, half Spanish historian in Islamic and Spanish history and art as our private guide! 
We learned all about the Alhambra - from its Islamic  beginnings through to its catholic transition. 
Above all Hector made it engaging by telling us at the start of the tour that he would be preparing us for a visit to the Sultan which was both an invitation that wasn’t wanted nor could it be refused!

title: A wonderful experience
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Our tour of the Alhambra Palace with our guide Fernando was a wonderful and unique experience. He was not just a tour guide, but was passionate about the history of the place, very knowledgeable, and explained the details and stories in an enjoyable way that made history come to life before your eyes.
